moments.title: Wales face Portugal in Nations League decider
moments.blurb: Wales will play Portugal at Cardiff City Stadium on Tuesday, November 17, in their final UEFA Nations League group game, following a 3-1 defeat to Norway today that confirmed they will finish bottom of League A.

angles.name: Nations League Hopes
angles.copy: After a tough 3-1 loss to Norway today, Wales are fighting to avoid relegation in the Nations League. Can they pull off a shock against Portugal on Tuesday? #WalesFootball

angles.name: Cardiff Match Preview
angles.copy: It's a huge night for Wales at Cardiff City Stadium on Tuesday as they host Portugal. The Dragons are already confirmed to finish bottom of their League A group, but will be playing for pride and a potential play-off spot. Get behind the boys!

moments.blurb: Although Black Friday officially falls on November 27, many UK retailers like Amazon, Currys, AO.com, Boots, Argos, and Smyths have already launched their sales, with Amazon's Black Friday Week running from November 19-30.

moments.title: Jamie Miller holds UK No.1 with 'Babydoll'
moments.blurb: Welsh artist Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart as of November 12, making him the first Welsh male solo artist to top the charts in 41 years.

angles.name: Welsh Chart Topper
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Welsh star Jamie Miller! His track 'Babydoll' is still number one on the UK Singles Chart, making history as the first Welsh male solo artist to hit the top in 41 years! #JamieMiller

angles.name: Babydoll Still Dominant
